central_findings.physical_inputs: Same two identities, same geometry, same semantic class, same timestamps and no extra measurements; consistently exchange numeric ID names only.
central_findings.scope: A deterministic public-API fixture, not an assertion that these exact numbers occurred in an official dataset.

central_findings.finding: Reliable coverage, same-state association and current-validity are different random events. Reusing q in separate thresholded factors does not establish a normalized joint posterior.
Only aggregate positive support and latest time reach the reducer; the actually supported cells are not provided. Treating the entire CURRENT mesh as observed is an approximation.

single_model_contract.state: Physical identity, temporal fragments, actual observed geometry and provenance; unresolved association is retained. Same/completed, moved, absent and invalid/stale observation are distinct hypotheses or latent paths, not four independent priors.
single_model_contract.observation_event: A fixed available evidence snapshot and its sensor timestamps. Repeated callbacks, finalization and numeric identity order are not extra measurements.
single_model_contract.one_prior: At event e use q_e derived from H_<e. Infer all affected identities against the same history snapshot. Stage resolved mobility updates; make them visible to subsequent observation events, not later IDs within the current traversal.
single_model_contract.one_likelihood: Use one joint law on the same depth/identity observations and visibility mask. Geometry copies and count summaries are functions of these observations; do not multiply them as independent sensors. Preserve finite-sample/selection uncertainty.
single_model_contract.one_decision: Apply one stated action risk to the joint state posterior. Association confidence alone does not justify discarding new geometry. State handover, displayed geometry and finalization must be consistent projections of that posterior.
single_model_contract.numerical_boundaries: A discrete output still selects an action; its comparison boundary must follow the loss and posterior. No fitted percentages, sigmoid widths, shifted q or changed error odds.
single_model_contract.frozen_parts: Keep existing CUSUM/log99, fixed input/scoring, mesh provenance and established temporal-state mechanisms. Their exact probabilistic limitations stay explicit.
